hypothesis: Registered after the adversarial review of the paper draft (2-3 Nov 2026), which asked for: compute-matched comparisons (E63), generation quality (E64), checkpoint selection without the exact score (E65), a stronger structured neural baseline (E66) and a vector-state proof of concept (E67). The user said 'Then go build those experiments'. Registered before any E63-E67 code was written or run. A reviewer will ask whether the gain comes from the BP structure or from likelihood training. E66 trains the SAME neural energy kernel (width 16) with the networks' own objective: denoising score matching on clean sequences, backpropagated through a differentiable grid BP (markov_score.bp_torch). It is a diffusion model whose denoiser is BP with a learned kernel, trained exactly like the networks.
design: The Laplace chain of E03 (alpha = 0.85, L = 32, variance 1, Laplace innovations), E03's bundles (e03._cell_common, tags exp31-*), the twelve log-spaced levels t = 0.05 ... 3, the 401-point grid on [-8, 8]. Seeds 0-15, N in (32, 128, 512, 2048). MODEL: NeuralEnergyKernel width 16 (uniform start: last layer zero), K normalised on the grid; the posterior mean by normalised forward-backward in torch, float64. TRAINING (E03's recipe): clean training chains, batch 64, each example at a level drawn from the twelve, fresh Gaussian noise every step, the eps-prediction loss with eps_hat = (x - alpha m_hat)/sqrt(Delta), Adam, gradient clipping 1, 32000 steps, checkpoints 500 ... 32000, selection by the validation score error (E03's rule; val_dsm recorded too). Training grid 201 points on [-8, 8] (resolution rule satisfied for t >= 0.05); evaluation on the 401 grid (the kernel is a function, not a table). LEARNING RATE: screened on dev seeds 10000-10001 at N = 32 and 2048 over (1e-3, 3e-3, 1e-2), 8000 steps, by validation error; the winner is used for every confirmatory fit.
